message:
docs(history): the failure moved backwards, not forwards

I wrote that the publish fix worked and the failure point had moved on. It had
moved the other way. run_update calls PrepareForSwap, then Quiesce, then Swap.
The 15:45 error is in Swap; the 18:56 error is in PrepareForSwap. So the earlier
run got further, and the later one died shallower -- the difference being that a
windowless child was alive at 18:56, not anything I changed.

So updater.log offers no evidence that the Setup recovery worked: the 18:56 run
never reached the stage that would check. "version verified: 0.2.109" is not
evidence of the required set either -- it covers signature and download only.

The recovery does stand, on separate grounds that do not depend on the log: the
mechanical comparison of the manifest against payloadNames, and ten public URLs
hashing as signed.

What I did wrong is worth keeping. I read two log lines, saw one was later, and
called it progress -- without checking which function each string lives in. Time
order says nothing about depth. The verifier made the same error independently
and withdrew it; when two of us are wrong the same way, each looks like
corroboration for the other.
